objective: Valley props and UI icons for v0.5: Blender sakura_large_a/b/c, hill_a/b/c (snow caps baked), spawn_pad and lantern to the 9.3 contract with manifest and register rows; the tools/icons Pillow pipeline drawing the 16 GardenConfig.ICON_SET decals at 128 px, their register rows and the GardenIcons ids once uploaded.
acceptance_criteria: Eight manifest rows (three sakura at 2500 tris, three hills at 1200, spawn_pad 1500, lantern 600) with the 9.3 sizes; build.py builds them under budget; sakura trunks are a 2.5-radius cylinder at the origin and canopies have no collision; hills have snow baked above 70% of the height; the lantern shade centre is at 3.6 studs

tools/icons/make_icons.py (Pillow, run with python -I) writes 16 deterministic 128 x 128 PNGs named garden_icon_<name> for every ICON_SET entry with the X1.5 style; running it twice gives identical bytes; tools/icons/README.md gives the upload and register steps

docs/assets/register.md has a row per model and per icon decal; src/shared/GardenAssets.luau and src/shared/GardenIcons.luau gain the ids after upload, nil until then; tests/GardenAssets.spec.luau passes with the new rows
A contact sheet of the 16 icons and a preview of each prop is attached to the checkpoint
verification: A15 checks the previews, the contact sheet and the register; CI runs GardenAssets.spec
notes: GardenIcons.luau is created by GARDEN-053 with nil ids; this task only fills ids (coordinate the merge order: whichever lands second edits the file). Pin the Pillow version in the script docstring. Decals are uploaded to SHANNON's account like meshes; no third-party icon packs (rule 9).
